description: Customer was charged a duplicate monthly account fee and asks for a refund of the extra charge.
Card statement shows the same merchant payment posted twice and the amount is over one thousand.
Customer disputes an incorrect late payment fee after paying on time.
Interest charged on loan statement does not match the agreed rate and it was already corrected once.
Customer reports unrecognised overseas card transactions and asks for the card to be blocked.
Online banking account takeover with multiple transfers to unknown beneficiaries draining the savings.
Small unauthorised subscription payment appeared on the debit card after a phishing sms.
Customer says the card was cloned at an ATM and several cash withdrawals were made.
Internet banking website was down for an hour and the customer could not pay a bill.
Mobile banking app login fails with an error after the latest update and the customer cannot access the account.
Mobile app crashes on login after the update and fingerprint login no longer works.
App login keeps failing with a verification error since the update and the customer is locked out.
After the app update users cannot log in to mobile banking and the one time password never arrives.
Mortgage application delayed for weeks because documents were lost and the customer asks to speed it up.
Loan disbursement did not happen on the promised date and the customer missed a property purchase deadline.
Customer received a wrong loan balance in the annual statement.
Prepayment of the home loan is not reflected in the outstanding amount.
Customer account is locked after several wrong password attempts and cannot reset it online.
Business account frozen after a compliance review with no explanation and salaries cannot be paid.
Customer cannot update the mobile number because the verification code is not received.
Customer complains a branch employee was rude and ignored the queue token.
An employee shared the customer's account details with a relative without consent.
Long waiting time at the branch and nobody explained the delay.
Customer was charged an annual card fee despite a lifetime free offer.
Several overdraft penalty fees were applied although the salary credit was only a day late.
Foreign currency markup fee is higher than quoted at account opening.
